claim_scope: synthetic worlds selected by rule; the references are listing-only rules and the full-information bound, not a model; no live cell has read this pack
selection_rule: seed s is offered to cell (s - start) mod 18, signals crossed with risks in v1's order; its numbers are drawn from inference_case_matrix.RANGES by a generator seeded with s; the world is admitted when the six listing-only rules separate in expectation (classify_world_by_policy_separation at 0.05 over 3 sample-noise seeds), the rule aligned with the declared signal solves the world (mean regret below 50.0 USD), the rule committed to the opposite direction loses to it by at least 0.05 of the bound and the full-information optimum sources at least 0.6 of its expected good units from good suppliers (capacity worlds exempt from both), and the cell is not yet full at 2; every world declares binomial sample noise and states its minimum-order level in the listing
